items.title: Registering the adapter makes `cli
items.body: Registering the adapter makes `cli.Check` return nine adapters and thirteen checks. The unchanged `TestCheckReportsAvailableContract` still expects eight adapters and twelve checks (`doctor_test.go:24,28`), so it deterministically fails. The supplied native checks exclude this CLI package.
items.suggestion: Update both doctor expectations and verify `./cmd/gomad/internal/cli`.

items.title: The new consumer and source-drift tests read the pinned metrics module without downloading it
items.body: The new consumer and source-drift tests read the pinned metrics module without downloading it. `pinnedModuleCache` only locates the cache. With an installed toolchain but no cached metrics module, running only `TestHashicorpMetrics*` fails before exercising the adapter. The supplied focused run masks this dependency by running the generic inventory test, which downloads the module first.
items.suggestion: Download the pinned module explicitly in each test that needs its sources, using the existing helper; alternatively, use `PrepareTargetBuildAdapters` for the consumer.
